sections.name: CommandPalette (part 1)
sections.title: Keyboard open and close
sections.what: Pulls the searchable lists and actions from the store. Listens across the whole window for Ctrl or Cmd plus K to open or close the palette, and for Escape to close it.
sections.why: Likely reason: a global shortcut that works from any screen.
sections.watch_out: Ctrl or Cmd plus K toggles the palette even while the user is typing in another box, because the check does not look at where focus is.

sections.name: CommandPalette: if
sections.title: Search filtering and navigation list
sections.what: Turns the search text into lowercase and filters tasks, habits, assignments, and internships. Builds the list of navigation commands that match. Clears the search text when closed and focuses the box when opened.
sections.why: Likely reason: one search box covers many kinds of items.
sections.watch_out: Habits and internships are filtered here, but no visible results section displays them, so their matches will not appear.

sections.name: CommandPalette (part 3)
sections.title: Navigation and task results
sections.what: Shows matching navigation commands, plus up to three matching tasks. Clicking a task toggles whether it is completed, then closes the palette.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets the user jump to a screen or tick off a task straight from search.
sections.watch_out: Clicking a task changes its status at once, so a stray click in search can mark a task done.

sections.name: CommandPalette (part 4)
sections.title: Assignment results
sections.what: Shows up to three matching assignments with their due dates. Clicking one opens the semester screen and closes the palette, but does not select that assignment.
sections.why: Likely reason: a shortcut to the semester tracker.
sections.watch_out: Only the screen opens, not the specific assignment, so the user still has to find it there.
